info.title: API.SH: Motorsport
info.description: The Motorsport API from API.SH: public Motorsport data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The tracks of a series: for NASCAR every track's type, surface, length, turns, banking, straightaway lengths, year built, capacity, owner, address, description, images and links; for MotoGP / Moto2 / Moto3 the circuits on a season's calendar with place, country and the events held there.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-circuits

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only circuits whose name or place contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A series' drivers or riders for a season. MotoGP, Moto2 and Moto3: every rider with number, team, constructor, country, birth date and photo, any season back to 2002; pass `driver` for a rider's profile (biography, height, weight, social links, career by season, season-by-season wins, podiums, poles, points and position, career totals per class, first and latest wins). NASCAR (current season): each driver's car number, manufacturer, points position, points, starts, wins, poles, top 5s and 10s, laps led, stage wins and DNFs. IndyCar: the season's drivers with points position and points.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-drivers

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season year (default the current one; NASCAR lists cover the current season).

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: MotoGP, Moto2 or Moto3 rider id (from this list) for the rider's profile.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every lap of every car in a NASCAR race: lap time, speed and running position per lap, with each driver's laps completed, best lap and average lap, and the flag state lap by lap. Filter to one driver or car number.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-lap-times

parameters.name: driver
parameters.description: Only this driver (name contains) or car number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A race's results. IndyCar: the finishing order; with `details=true` also each driver's grid position, car number, team, owner, engine, sponsor, laps completed and led, laps and time behind, championship, bonus and penalty points, pit stops and fastest lap where published.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-results

parameters.name: race
parameters.description: Race id from `/motorsport/v1/schedule` (NASCAR number, MotoGP event id, IndyCar number).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: NASCAR: the race's season (default: found from the race id, last seven seasons). IndyCar: needed only when the race id does not start with its year.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: MotoGP classes: RAC (default), SPR, Q1, Q2, FP1, FP2, PR, WUP.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: IndyCar: true adds each driver's grid, car, team, laps, laps led, gaps, points, pit stops and fastest lap (slower).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: NASCAR, MotoGP and IndyCar season schedule
get.description:
A series' season calendar. MotoGP / Moto2 / Moto3: event id, name, sponsored name, dates, country, circuit, status. IndyCar: race id, name, date, status and winner. Use the race id with `/motorsport/v1/results`. Formula 1 is in `/formula-1/v1/*`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-schedule

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Championship standings: MotoGP / Moto2 / Moto3 (position, rider, number, country, team, bike, points, wins, podiums, recent finishes) or IndyCar (position, driver, country, points). NASCAR points are in each race's results (`points_position`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-standings

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The teams of a MotoGP, Moto2 or Moto3 season: name, type (factory or independent), constructor, colors, picture, social links and their riders (number, nationality, birth date, photo).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/motorsport-teams

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
